why: These three docs (all required 'read in this order' reading per index.md itself) describe a codebase that no longer exists: there is no app_database.dart (it is lib/core/database/user/user_database.dart, class UserDatabase, schemaVersion 32 with 24 tables and 24 registered DAOs, not v4/v15 with 23 tables/20 DAOs); the Content DB has 4 tables (daily_content is missing from every doc's list) at schema v5, not 3 at v3; the feature list is 18 old names (auth, parent_mode, learning_order, stages, test_tracking, track_setup, tutor_mode) when lib/features/ actually has 15 (account, sacred_time, tracks, tutoring, etc. — several renamed/merged); test/story_acceptance/ has 57 files today, not 15; and the ~366/182 file counts are roughly half the current 720 hand-written lib files / 780 test files. A contributor or agent using these docs to reason about the schema, DAOs, or feature boundaries will build a wrong mental model and can violate layering rules unknowingly (e.g. importing a dropped table's companion class, as testing-guide.md's own examples do — see the paired finding).
recommendation: Re-run the document-project/architecture-scan workflow that originally produced these three files against current HEAD (it already exists and was used once, per docs/project-scan-report.json) rather than hand-patching individual numbers, since nearly every count in the DB/feature/file sections has drifted.
